svg.aria-label: Forge seam and its first adapter
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Forge seam and its first adapter
svg.desc: The CLI talks to the `Forge` trait; the GitHub adapter implements it over a `GhClient`, and `RealGh` is the only thing that spawns the tool.

g.text: OSF CLI · COMMAND DISPATCH IN MAIN.RS
FORGE CORE · PROVIDER-NEUTRAL TRAIT AND REPORT…
ADAPTERS · GITHUB OVER THE GH COMMAND LINE
